name: HC37g: Treated for Cryptococcal Meningitis
description:
Number of active non-suppressed ART clients with CD4 below 200 who were diagnosed with cryptococcal meningitis and treated for CCM.
Both diagnosed_with_cryptococcal_meningitis = 'YES' and treated_for_ccm = 'YES'.
creator: 82f18b44-6814-11e8-923f-e9a88dcb533f
configJson:
{
  "version": 1,
  "patientIdColumn": "patient_id",
  "populationQuery": {
    "extractFrom": "sqlTemplate"
  },
  "supportsRedisaggregation": true,
  "redisaggregationStrategy": "population-extraction",
  "themeIndependent": true,
  "dataSources": [
    "mamba_fact_encounter_non_suppressed_card",
    "mamba_fact_test_orders_results",

  "sqlTemplate": "SELECT DISTINCT n.patient_id
FROM mamba_fact_encounter_non_suppressed_card n
WHERE n.patient_id IS NOT NULL
  AND n.encounter_date >= :startDate
  AND n.encounter_date < DATE_ADD(:endDate, INTERVAL 1 DAY)

  AND UPPER(TRIM(n.diagnosed_with_cryptococcal_meningitis)) = 'YES'
  AND UPPER(TRIM(n.treated_for_ccm)) = 'YES'

  AND EXISTS (
      SELECT 1
      FROM mamba_fact_test_orders_results c
      WHERE c.patient_id = n.patient_id
        AND UPPER(TRIM(c.test_parameter)) = 'CD4 COUNT'
        AND c.encounter_datetime <= n.encounter_date
        AND TRIM(c.test_value) REGEXP '^[0-9]+([.][0-9]+)?$'
        AND CAST(c.test_value AS DECIMAL(10,2)) < 200
        AND NOT EXISTS (
            SELECT 1
            FROM mamba_fact_test_orders_results c2
            WHERE c2.patient_id = c.patient_id
              AND UPPER(TRIM(c2.test_parameter)) = 'CD4 COUNT'
              AND c2.encounter_datetime <= n.encounter_date
              AND TRIM(c2.test_value) REGEXP '^[0-9]+([.][0-9]+)?$'
              AND (
                  c2.encounter_datetime > c.encounter_datetime
                  OR (
                      c2.encounter_datetime = c.encounter_datetime
                      AND c2.id > c.id
                  )
              )
        )
  )

  AND EXISTS (
      SELECT 1
      FROM mamba_fact_viral_load_episode v
      WHERE v.patient_id = n.patient_id
        AND v.result_status = 'VALID'
        AND v.is_unsuppressed = 1
        AND v.is_suppressed = 0
        AND COALESCE(
              v.sample_collection_date,
              v.viral_load_clinical_date,
              v.laboratory_result_date,
              v.order_date
            ) <= n.encounter_date
        AND NOT EXISTS (
            SELECT 1
            FROM mamba_fact_viral_load_episode v2
            WHERE v2.patient_id = v.patient_id
              AND v2.result_status = 'VALID'
              AND COALESCE(
                    v2.sample_collection_date,
                    v2.viral_load_clinical_date,
                    v2.laboratory_result_date,
                    v2.order_date
                  ) <= n.encounter_date

                  COALESCE(
                      v2.sample_collection_date,
                      v2.viral_load_clinical_date,
                      v2.laboratory_result_date,
                      v2.order_date
                  ) >
                  COALESCE(
                      v.sample_collection_date,
                      v.viral_load_clinical_date,
                      v.laboratory_result_date,
                      v.order_date
                  )
                  OR (
                      COALESCE(
                          v2.sample_collection_date,
                          v2.viral_load_clinical_date,
                          v2.laboratory_result_date,
                          v2.order_date
                      ) =
                      COALESCE(
                          v.sample_collection_date,
                          v.viral_load_clinical_date,
                          v.laboratory_result_date,
                          v.order_date
                      )
                      AND v2.episode_id > v.episode_id
                  )
              )
        )
  )

  AND EXISTS (
      SELECT 1
      FROM mamba_fact_encounter_hiv_art_card a
      WHERE a.patient_id = n.patient_id
        AND (
            (
                a.encounter_date >= :startDate
                AND a.encounter_date < DATE_ADD(:endDate, INTERVAL 1 DAY)
            )
            OR a.return_visit_date > :endDate
        )
  );",

sqlTemplate:
SELECT DISTINCT n.patient_id
FROM mamba_fact_encounter_non_suppressed_card n
WHERE n.patient_id IS NOT NULL
  AND n.encounter_date >= :startDate
  AND n.encounter_date < DATE_ADD(:endDate, INTERVAL 1 DAY)

  AND UPPER(TRIM(n.diagnosed_with_cryptococcal_meningitis)) = 'YES'
  AND UPPER(TRIM(n.treated_for_ccm)) = 'YES'

  AND EXISTS (
      SELECT 1
      FROM mamba_fact_test_orders_results c
      WHERE c.patient_id = n.patient_id
        AND UPPER(TRIM(c.test_parameter)) = 'CD4 COUNT'
        AND c.encounter_datetime <= n.encounter_date
        AND TRIM(c.test_value) REGEXP '^[0-9]+([.][0-9]+)?$'
        AND CAST(c.test_value AS DECIMAL(10,2)) < 200
        AND NOT EXISTS (
            SELECT 1
            FROM mamba_fact_test_orders_results c2
            WHERE c2.patient_id = c.patient_id
              AND UPPER(TRIM(c2.test_parameter)) = 'CD4 COUNT'
              AND c2.encounter_datetime <= n.encounter_date
              AND TRIM(c2.test_value) REGEXP '^[0-9]+([.][0-9]+)?$'
              AND (
                  c2.encounter_datetime > c.encounter_datetime
                  OR (
                      c2.encounter_datetime = c.encounter_datetime
                      AND c2.id > c.id
                  )
              )
        )
  )

  AND EXISTS (
      SELECT 1
      FROM mamba_fact_viral_load_episode v
      WHERE v.patient_id = n.patient_id
        AND v.result_status = 'VALID'
        AND v.is_unsuppressed = 1
        AND v.is_suppressed = 0
        AND COALESCE(
              v.sample_collection_date,
              v.viral_load_clinical_date,
              v.laboratory_result_date,
              v.order_date
            ) <= n.encounter_date
        AND NOT EXISTS (
            SELECT 1
            FROM mamba_fact_viral_load_episode v2
            WHERE v2.patient_id = v.patient_id
              AND v2.result_status = 'VALID'
              AND COALESCE(
                    v2.sample_collection_date,
                    v2.viral_load_clinical_date,
                    v2.laboratory_result_date,
                    v2.order_date
                  ) <= n.encounter_date
              AND (
                  COALESCE(
                      v2.sample_collection_date,
                      v2.viral_load_clinical_date,
                      v2.laboratory_result_date,
                      v2.order_date
                  ) >
                  COALESCE(
                      v.sample_collection_date,
                      v.viral_load_clinical_date,
                      v.laboratory_result_date,
                      v.order_date
                  )
                  OR (
                      COALESCE(
                          v2.sample_collection_date,
                          v2.viral_load_clinical_date,
                          v2.laboratory_result_date,
                          v2.order_date
                      ) =
                      COALESCE(
                          v.sample_collection_date,
                          v.viral_load_clinical_date,
                          v.laboratory_result_date,
                          v.order_date
                      )
                      AND v2.episode_id > v.episode_id
                  )
              )
        )
  )

  AND EXISTS (
      SELECT 1
      FROM mamba_fact_encounter_hiv_art_card a
      WHERE a.patient_id = n.patient_id
        AND (
            (
                a.encounter_date >= :startDate
                AND a.encounter_date < DATE_ADD(:endDate, INTERVAL 1 DAY)
            )
            OR a.return_visit_date > :endDate
        )
  );
